propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) were missed during migration.

Four CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' because external tests are excluded from the standard Verified gate and thus the removal was not caught.

The replacement API review_plan() cannot satisfy the existing test assertions because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT without top-level findings, whereas tests expect REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings fields.
Both external test modules must be retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() (the surviving op returning REVIEW_RESULT) with updated assertions matching the correct result contract.
External tests were skipped during the removal epic's validation run, causing the regression to be invisible until a live workflow_dispatch execution.
